flashcard_questions.q: What is sampling in digital audio?
flashcard_questions.a: Measuring an analogue sound wave at regular intervals to convert it to digital.
The number of times per second a sound wave is measured, in Hertz.
The number of bits used to record each individual sample.

flashcard_questions.q: What sample rate is the standard for CD-quality music?
What bit depth does CD-quality audio use?
How many amplitude levels can a 16-bit recording represent?
Which sample rate is used in professional video and broadcast audio?
Which sample rate suits speech recordings where file size must be small?
Why is a stereo file about twice the size of a mono file?
flashcard_questions.a: It contains two channels of data instead of one.

flashcard_questions.q: Which audio format is uncompressed and standard for editing on any system?
Which audio format is Apple's uncompressed equivalent of WAV?
Which lossy audio format is supported on virtually every device?
Which lossy format gives better quality than MP3 at the same file size?
Which lossless format compresses audio to about half the size of WAV?
Which open-source lossy format has no licensing fees?

notes: 15 cards: 3 property-to-meaning, 5 numerical property cards, 1 causal, 6 format-to-use. One format per card; ALAC dropped because its description repeats FLAC's and would interfere.
